The '''414th Infantry Support Regiment''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] formation commanded by a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]]. The colonel was also the de facto [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]].<ref name="Journal">{{JournalCite|2|You're in the Army Now!}}</ref>
